title: eludite.debug.toggle_breakpoint output
description: The compact answer of eludite.debug.toggle_breakpoint (brief 0034): what the call did, the breakpoint's row, whether a live session bound it, and how many breakpoints there are. The other breakpoints, the frames and the locals are in eludite.debug.state; the commands that run the program answer with the stop summary.

action.description: `added` (a new breakpoint), `changed` (one on that line or function existed), `deleted` (the call removed it, a `toggle` on a line that had one included) or `deleted_all`.

kind.description: `line` (a breakpoint on a line), `tracepoint` (a line breakpoint with `log_message`: When Hit, print a message and continue) or `function` (a function breakpoint, by `function`; no path or line).

path.description: The source file (absent for a function breakpoint).

verified.description: The adapter bound it to code: in any live session (each session's binding is in `sessions`); after the last session ended, as that session left it.

hits.description: Times it was reached, summed over the live sessions (a tracepoint's hits count its lines); after the last session ended, that session's count.

message.description: Why it is not bound, from the adapter.

remove_after.description: Deleted at its first visible stop ("Delete breakpoint when hit").

temporary.description: Set by eludite.debug.run_until or eludite.debug.trace for the length of that call and removed after it; never persisted. The Breakpoints window marks it.

sessions.description: Per live session (brief 0028): whether that session's adapter bound it, its hits there and why it is not bound. Breakpoints are shared: every change is sent to every session's adapter.

message.description: Why that session's adapter has not bound it: still pending (its code has not loaded) or failed (no code on the line, the condition rejected).

breakpoint.description: The breakpoint the call added or changed, as the Breakpoints window lists it (eludite.debug.state's `breakpoints` row): `verified` and `hits` over the live sessions, `sessions` per live session.

verified.description: A live session's adapter has bound the breakpoint to code. False after a delete, while no session runs (breakpoints bind when a session starts) and while `pending`.

pending.description: A session runs and its adapter has not answered the change yet. An agent's call waits up to 500 ms for every live session's answer, the person's never; eludite.debug.state shows the binding later, and a stop at the line shows it bound.

message.description: Why a live session's adapter refused the breakpoint, once it answered (brief 0036): the line has no code, or the condition was rejected. The breakpoint never stops there until it is changed. Each session's binding is in `breakpoint.sessions`; a binding that waits for its code to load is not a refusal and has no message here.

session.description: The active debugging session's id (brief 0028), when a session runs.

breakpoints_total.description: How many breakpoints there are after the call: line breakpoints, tracepoints and function breakpoints, temporary ones included.
